title: Persona compile undo and description history snapshotting

sections.what: Snapshot previous `base_description`, `personality`, `interest_tags`, and `fear_tags` before committing a persona compile, allowing the author to revert back to their prior authored prose with a single click in the Persona tab.
sections.why: Compiling a structured persona block rewrites the character's primary prose fields. If the compiled result is less nuanced than hand-crafted prose, authors currently have no easy way to revert without manually restoring from git or backups.
sections.how:
- Store `_last_precompile_snapshot` on `Node.properties` (or in client session history) containing `{ "base_description": ..., "personality": ..., "interest_tags": ..., "fear_tags": ... }`.
- Add a "Revert to pre-compile" button in the Persona tab sticky bar when a snapshot is present.
- Provide an API endpoint `POST /api/players/<name>/record/revert_compile` to restore the snapshot.

acceptance.text: Compiling a persona automatically captures a snapshot of the overwritten fields.
Authors can revert compiled prose back to the pre-compile state.
Snapshot does not leak into public scenario exports or bloated graph payloads.
